National Library Maharajganj Azamgarh – Self Study Library

National Library in Maharajganj, Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh 276137 is a quiet self-study library for SSC, Railway, UP Police, Bank, TET and board exam students. 68 seats, free 5G Wi-Fi, open 7 AM to 9 PM every day, fee ₹400 per month.

Online seat availability, fee payment, student portal, attendance, free mock tests, daily quiz and AI doubt solving. Call +91 87950 11001.

Our mission

Gaon aur kasbe ke har mehnati student ko shehar jaisi suvidha apne hi ilaake mein dena, taaki taiyari ke liye bahar na jaana pade. Yahan padhai ke saath discipline, regular attendance aur digital tools ek hi jagah milte hain.

FAQ

Fee kitni hai?

₹400 per month. 6 mahine ke liye ₹2400.

Library kab khulti hai?

Roz subah 7 baje se raat 9 baje tak. Sunday ko subah 8 baje se shaam 5 baje tak. Holiday ki jaankari notice board par milti hai.

Admission kaise lein?

Students → Register mein form bharein. Manager approval ke baad login ho jata hai.

Seat kaise chunein?

Registration ke time khali seats dikhti hain, jo seat pasand ho us par tap karein.
